A type of '''transport''' utilized by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] during the [[War against Zakuul]]. It was capable to deploy two [[World thrasher|World Thrashers]] on the battlefield. At least three transports of this class were used to deploy World Thrashers during the [[Assault on Odessen]]<ref name="Chapter 8" /> in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.0}}</ref>
